retired.note: HS 2022 renumbered LED lamps from 8539.50 to 8539.52. All of 8539.50 went there, but 8539.52 also absorbed LED lamps previously reported under 8539.90, 8543.70 and several 9405 subheadings, so it is broader than this code was.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
